info.title: web-dash API
info.description: web-dash: authentication, link/group management, visual customization and widgets, declarative JSON API addons with encrypted secret inputs, uploaded backgrounds and icons, home CSS, HTTP checks, Nginx/Caddy import, Docker discovery and read-only Docker/host metrics.
